observations: Hydrogenated Starch Hydrolysate and Glycerin are early humectant/feel components before and after SLES.
SLES plus Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine and Coco-Glucoside indicates an ordinary cleanser system with amphoteric/nonionic support.
Allantoin, Bisabolol, Zinc PCA, Panthenol and tea extract are present, but no anti-itch clinical evidence is captured.
Parfum is present, so sensitive-scalp suitability cannot be upgraded from formula-only evidence.
